mapIdentity.scope: The official heritage boundary identifies the monument and the separately mapped outlines locate the primary buildings. The original 5 m terrain locates the compound relative to the shoreline and adjacent slope.

note: Two-storey L-shaped former filter house, red brick, contrasting Shanghai plaster, an upper seaward verandah and an exterior stair.
